name: session-cap
description: A per-session context cap (200k tokens by default): a Stop hook that trips once at the cap, a /handover skill that writes a handover document from disk, a ledger, a context report and a status line.

context.content: Run `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_cap.py" ctx $ARGUMENTS` and show its table as is. Then name, in one line each, any session marked `HANDOVER DUE` (at the cap with no handover yet) and any session above 80% of the cap.
context.description: Show the context used by recently active sessions against the cap
